featured_items.title_zh: T2T 技术报告：从海量无标注软件教学视频自动合成大规模可执行 GUI 轨迹
featured_items.title_en: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
featured_items.one_line_pain: 针对人工录制桌面与手机操作轨迹成本高难扩规模的瓶颈，四阶段自动将公开教学视频转为可执行训练轨迹

metric_badges.text: 横跨 4 大基准零人工标注涨点

featured_items.abstract_en:
Training generalist GUI and computer-use agents requires massive interaction trajectories pairing screenshots with grounded UI actions, while manual human demonstrations are costly to scale. Public video tutorials contain rich operational workflows, yet continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries and spatial coordinates. We present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a 4-stage automated pipeline integrating active segment filtering, localized UI-change keyframe extraction, shortcut-free frame selection, and 2-stage action-space normalization across desktop, web, and mobile platforms. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B on T2T trajectories without target-domain human annotations yields consistent gains across OSWorld, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench (4 benchmarks total). Project code and weights: https://github.com/t2t-gui/tutorial-to-trajectory and https://huggingface.co/t2t-gui/T2T-7B .
[Comment: Technical Report, code and 7B checkpoint released]

four_elements.pain_point: 训练通用 GUI 智能体极度依赖“截图—精确动作坐标”配对轨迹，人工逐条录制既贵又慢；网上虽有海量软件教学视频，但连续视频流没有离散动作边界、语义意图和精确点击坐标，直接喂给模型会学到大量无效帧捷径。
four_elements.mechanism: 提出 4 阶段全自动管线 T2T（Tutorial-to-Trajectory）：① 活跃操作片段过滤剔除口播废片；② 基于局部界面像素变化提取关键帧；③ 防捷径观测帧筛选避免未来视觉泄露；④ 存在性感知定位与 2 阶段动作空间归一化，统一桌面、网页和移动端动作格式。
four_elements.experiments_summary: 完全不使用目标域人工标注演示数据，用 T2T 合成轨迹微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 后，在 OSWorld、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl 与 AgentNetBench 共 4 个跨平台基准上均取得一致泛化提升。
four_elements.repro_and_reference: 代码与 7B 权重均已公开（GitHub ★ 215，HF 91 upvotes），可直接作为 GUI 强化学习阶段的冷启动 SFT 基座或合成轨迹数据源。

featured_items.title_zh: OODConceptBench（港浸会韩波组）：零样本视觉—语言 OOD 检测的词义碰撞审计与词表校准
featured_items.title_en: What Remains OOD? OODConceptBench and Lexical Calibration for Zero-Shot Vision-Language OOD Detection
featured_items.one_line_pain: 针对静态 WordNet 负标签词表存在一词多义和近义词碰撞推高误报的问题，审计并剪枝歧义负词
featured_items.abstract_en:
Negative-label zero-shot OOD detectors such as NegLabel mine large WordNet noun corpora with CLIP text-image similarity, yet static negative lexicons suffer from lexical polysemy and near-synonym collisions with ID classes, inflating FPR95 on fine-grained benchmarks. Using a training-free single-GPU evaluation pipeline on CLIP-ViT-B/16 across ImageNet-1K and 4 standard OOD datasets, OODConceptBench audits residual false positives and introduces lexical collision pruning, reducing average FPR95 by 4.6% and reaching 95.1% AUROC. Code and lexical lists at https://github.com/ood-concept/OODConceptBench .
[Comment: Updated v2 with full WordNet collision audit]

four_elements.pain_point: 以 NegLabel 为代表的零样本 VLM OOD 方法直接从 WordNet 拉取大规模名词做负标签，但自然语言词表存在严重的一词多义与细粒度近义词重叠，部分负标签与已知类（ID）语义撞车，导致细粒度样本被误判为未知类、推高 FPR95。
four_elements.mechanism: 构建 OODConceptBench 系统审计静态负词表上的残余假阳性来源，提出免训练词义碰撞剪枝与校准策略，剔除与已知类视觉—文本分布发生局部重叠的歧义负概念。
four_elements.experiments_summary: 基于 CLIP-ViT-B/16 单卡免训练管线，在 ImageNet-1K 与 4 个标准 OOD 测试集上将平均 FPR95 降低 4.6%，平均 AUROC 提升至 95.1%。
four_elements.repro_and_reference: 出自双方向重点追踪的香港浸会大学韩波组，代码与清洗后词表已开源，单张常规 GPU 即可复现全部词表碰撞消融。

featured_items.title_zh: Oregon State 实证归因：提供教程时桌面智能体几乎无法从世界模型推演中获益
featured_items.title_en: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
featured_items.one_line_pain: 针对教程检索、判分器与世界模型混用时增益归因不清的痛点，剥离验证三者在桌面任务中的真实贡献

metric_badges.text: 100% 真实未来帧仍无显著增益

featured_items.abstract_en:
Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component—tutorials, the judge, and the world model—to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: 2 datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. Comparing RAG-PJ with zero-shot text next-state world models and an oracle visual future across 3 evaluation settings, we find RAG-PJ gains little benefit from predicted rollouts when tutorials are present, even with 100% ground-truth visual futures. Code and benchmarks at https://github.com/oregon-state-cua/osworld-tutorial .
[Comment: 18 pages, 2 benchmarks (OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial)]

four_elements.pain_point: 近期不少桌面智能体同时堆叠“检索操作教程 + 世界模型预测下一步画面 + 多模态判分器选动作”，算力开销翻倍，但没人拆开验证到底是教程起了作用，还是世界模型推演真的帮上了忙。
four_elements.mechanism: 作者先构建带多模态图文教程的 OSWorld-Tutorial 与 ScienceBoard-Tutorial 两个数据集，再设计 RAG-PolicyJudge（策略提候选动作、判分器依据教程挑动作），在 3 种设置下严格对比“不加世界模型”“零样本文字预测下一状态”以及“直接给 100% 真实未来屏幕画面（Oracle）”的效果差异。
four_elements.experiments_summary: 在 OSWorld-Tutorial 与 ScienceBoard-Tutorial 共 2 套基准、3 类对比设置下实测发现：一旦提供了任务相关教程，即便把世界模型换成 100% 准确的真实未来视觉帧，RAG-PJ 的成功率提升依然微乎其微；真正卡脖子的是判分器对未来状态及任务是否完成的推理判别能力。
four_elements.repro_and_reference: 已开源代码与两套教程基准（GitHub ★ 142，HF Daily Papers 同步上榜）。结论对高校小算力团队极具启发：不必耗费巨资训练重型像素级世界模型，把精力放在强化多模态判分器（Judge/Verifier）的状态判别准确率上性价比高得多。

featured_items.title_zh: SE-GA（天大 & 上海交大 ICML 2026）：4×A800 跑通 7B GUI 智能体记忆增强自进化 RL
featured_items.title_en: SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents
featured_items.one_line_pain: 针对高校 4 卡显存受限且多轮 RL 易遗忘历史成功技能的痛点，结合情景技能记忆与 LoRA 自进化训练

metric_badges.text: 覆盖 3 大移动端与定位基准

featured_items.venue_or_source: Accepted by ICML 2026 (camera-ready v2 update) (arXiv cs.CL)
featured_items.abstract_en:
Deploying 7B open-weight GUI agents under limited academic compute often suffers from catastrophic forgetting and low sample efficiency during multi-turn reinforcement learning. We introduce SE-GA, a memory-augmented 2-stage self-evolution framework for Qwen2.5-VL-7B. All experiments are conducted using 4 NVIDIA A800 GPUs, where Stage 2 reinforcement learning applies LoRA to reduce GPU memory footprint while maintaining an episodic skill memory across ScreenSpot, AndroidControl, and AndroidWorld (3 benchmarks). Code available at https://github.com/tju-sjtu-gui/SE-GA .
[Comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 (camera-ready v2 update)]

four_elements.pain_point: 高校常规 4 卡服务器做 7B 多模态模型全参数多轮强化学习极易显存爆满，且探索过程中偶发试对的高价值操作序列很快在后续策略更新中被遗忘，样本效率低。
four_elements.mechanism: 围绕 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 设计 2 阶段记忆增强自进化框架（SE-GA）：外挂情景技能记忆库存储高回报子轨迹辅助规划，第二阶段自进化 RL 采用 LoRA 轻量参数更新大幅压缩显存占用。
four_elements.experiments_summary: 全部实验仅使用 4 张 NVIDIA A800 GPU 完成，在 ScreenSpot、AndroidControl 与 AndroidWorld 共 3 个标准基准上验证了记忆回放加 LoRA RL 的持续自进化增益。
four_elements.repro_and_reference: 天津大学与上海交大张倬胜老师合作（ICML 2026 主会 v2 更新），是已核实高校 GUI 强化学习论文中算力门槛最低（仅 4×A800）的 7B 训练范例，极适合对标复现。

featured_items.abstract_en: Anthropic rolls out Claude Computer Use in beta across Team and Enterprise plans. Claude captures desktop screens, navigates native applications, and executes click/type actions under strict organization-level admin controls (disabled by default, explicit allowlist per workspace, and untrusted screen prompt-injection masking across 100% of external browser views).
